import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] comb_table = new long[2500][2500];
    static int n_rows, n_cols;
    static long total_paths;
    static long min_gap = (long)1e18;
    static long best_answer = -1;
    static char[] input_line;
    static int[] prefix_A;
    static int[] prefix_B;
    static Map<Long, Long> dp_cache;

    static void explore_paths(long val1, long val2, int idx1, int idx2) {
        long gap = Math.abs(val1 - val2);
        if (min_gap <= 1 || gap - comb_table[idx1][n_rows] * comb_table[idx2][n_rows] >= min_gap)
            return;
            
        if (idx1 == n_rows - 1 && idx2 == n_rows - 1) {
            long current_gap = Math.abs(val1 - val2);
            if (current_gap < min_gap) {
                min_gap = current_gap;
                best_answer = val1;
            }
            return;
        }
        
        if (idx1 >= n_rows) {
            long increment1 = comb_table[idx1][n_rows] - comb_table[idx1 - 1][n_rows];
            long sum2 = comb_table[idx2][n_rows];
            explore_paths(val1, val2 + increment1 * sum2, idx1 - 1, idx2);
        }
        
        if (idx2 >= n_rows) {
            long sum1 = comb_table[idx1][n_rows];
            long increment2 = comb_table[idx2][n_rows] - comb_table[idx2 - 1][n_rows];
            explore_paths(val1 + sum1 * increment2, val2, idx1, idx2 - 1);
        }
    }

    static long count_valid_paths(long val1, long val2, int idx1, int idx2) {
        long state_id = val1 * 10000 + idx1 * 100 + idx2;
        if (dp_cache.containsKey(state_id))
            return dp_cache.get(state_id);
            
        long gap = Math.abs(val1 - val2);
        if (gap - comb_table[idx1][n_rows] * comb_table[idx2][n_rows] > min_gap) {
            dp_cache.put(state_id, 0L);
            return 0;
        }
        
        if (idx1 < n_rows || idx2 < n_rows) {
            if (idx1 >= prefix_A[idx1 + idx2] && idx2 >= prefix_B[idx1 + idx2]) {
                int total = idx1 + idx2;
                idx1 -= prefix_A[total];
                idx2 -= prefix_B[total];
                long result = comb_table[total][idx1];
                dp_cache.put(state_id, result);
                return result;
            }
            dp_cache.put(state_id, 0L);
            return 0;
        }
        
        long optimal = 0;
        char current_char = input_line[idx1 + idx2 - 1];
        if (current_char != 'B') {
            long increment1 = comb_table[idx1][n_rows] - comb_table[idx1 - 1][n_rows];
            long sum2 = comb_table[idx2][n_rows];
            optimal += count_valid_paths(val1, val2 + increment1 * sum2, idx1 - 1, idx2);
        }
        if (current_char != 'A') {
            long sum1 = comb_table[idx1][n_rows];
            long increment2 = comb_table[idx2][n_rows] - comb_table[idx2 - 1][n_rows];
            optimal += count_valid_paths(val1 + sum1 * increment2, val2, idx1, idx2 - 1);
        }
        dp_cache.put(state_id, optimal);
        return optimal;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n_rows = scanner.nextInt();
        n_cols = scanner.nextInt();
        scanner.nextLine(); // consume newline
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (n_rows + n_cols); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * (n_rows + n_cols); j++) {
                if (j == 0) comb_table[i][j] = 1;
                else if (i == 0) comb_table[i][j] = 0;
                else comb_table[i][j] = comb_table[i - 1][j] + comb_table[i - 1][j - 1];
            }
        }
        
        total_paths = comb_table[n_rows + n_cols][n_rows] * comb_table[n_rows + n_cols][n_rows];
        
        {
            long a = 0, b = 0;
            int i = n_rows + n_cols, j = n_rows + n_cols;
            while (i >= n_rows && j >= n_rows) {
                if (a > b) {
                    long increment1 = comb_table[i][n_rows] - comb_table[i - 1][n_rows];
                    long sum2 = comb_table[j][n_rows];
                    b += increment1 * sum2;
                    i--;
                } else {
                    long sum1 = comb_table[i][n_rows];
                    long increment2 = comb_table[j][n_rows] - comb_table[j - 1][n_rows];
                    a += sum1 * increment2;
                    j--;
                }
            }
            min_gap = Math.abs(a - b);
        }
        
        input_line = scanner.nextLine().toCharArray();
        prefix_A = new int[input_line.length + 1];
        prefix_B = new int[input_line.length + 1];
        prefix_A[0] = prefix_B[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < input_line.length; i++) {
            prefix_A[i + 1] = prefix_A[i] + (input_line[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            prefix_B[i + 1] = prefix_B[i] + (input_line[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        
        dp_cache = new HashMap<>();
        long final_count = count_valid_paths(0, 0, n_rows + n_cols, n_rows + n_cols);
        System.out.println(final_count);
    }
}
